main_text.l: IOANNI ESYCHIO BRE- MENSI QVVM NOMEN MEVM in album amicorum reciperet.

l.i: VNgamus ergo, ceu petis, Esychi Fidas amico foedere dexteras, Quod fraude iuratum remota Phoebus amet facilésque Musa.
Unica vatum pectora nam probant Quos celsa Pindi culmina visere, Sacrosque fontes, & virentis Fronde volunt decorare lauri.
Sic, sic alumnos Pegasidum chori, Et quos eisdem sub penetralibus Eduxit aussex Phoebus, idem Nectat amor citharae placentis:

Sint ista nostri foederis Esychi Testes perennis carmina quae damus Túque, ô, fideli semper huius Sculpta sinu monumenta serua Ornate multis nominibus liber: Queis lucis addit perpetuae decus Doctrina Lipsi, quae per orbem Usque micat memorata totum.

page.notes: The initial V of the first stanza is a large woodcut initial (rendered as "V" joined to "ngamus"; the printed letter is an ornamental I/V). Reading of "Vngamus" and "Unica" uncertain at the initial. The catchword "IOAN-" is set at the lower right. Greek and Latin letters as printed; the "Vngamus" form is copied as printed.
